title: Sustained versus transient content information
scientific_question: Can a bounded investigation correctly estimate and interpret all prespecified sustained-versus-transient category-information contrasts on the fixed COGITATE experiment1 MEG panel, retaining duration/offset and task-relevance alternatives?
primary_outputs: The independently recomputed orientation-balanced accuracy cells and signed temporal contrasts under one fixed crossvalidated estimator. A positive sustained-content effect is not a known answer.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: All eligible face/object trials for the declared33people, three durations500/1000/1500ms, two relevance conditions and three orientations; labels are observed analysis inputs here.
Six fixed good magnetometers in original author epochs; no additional filtering/smoothing/resampling. Baseline[-0.5,-0.3)s; six-sensor means over fixed200-ms pre/onset/middle/late/post windows.
Task instructions and helper schemas inA; same observations plus original author-source evidence inB.
forbidden_inputs: Independent benchmark reference report, private fitted states or grading feedback.
A labeled NEURAL-098 packet before a claimed unexposed NEURAL-097 evaluation on this source family.
Query-person/physical-image fitting, label-aware test pseudotrials or imputation of structurally unavailable late windows.

allowed_inputs.split: For each held participant×image half, train only1500-ms trials of the other32participants and opposite image identities; all repetitions/orientations of an image stay together. primary.name: Equal-participant mean absolute accuracy-cell reconstruction error (calibration endpoint)
primary.aggregation: Average absolute error over42fixed cells within participant, then equally across33participants.
primary.rationale: This is what the delivered score.py implements. It measures faithful execution of the declared analysis, not scientific insight; an understanding claim additionally requires independently scored supported interpretations, which this artifact-only scorer does not establish.

secondary: Equal-participant mean absolute signed-contrast reconstruction error across24contrasts.
All24 signed means and participant SD/descriptive SE reported without significance selection.
Proposed interpretation endpoint: correct estimator/offset/relevance/support claims against independently computed evidence; current numeric scorer does not grade these claims.

comparators.name: Independent fixed logistic-analysis reference
comparators.inputs: Same labeled six-sensor observations, physically separated training participant/images.
comparators.procedure: Declared LogisticRegression(C=1,liblinear,tol=1e-8,max_iter=2000,random_state=98098); training-only scaling and participant×class×relevance×orientation weights; diagonal and onset-transfer predictions. Convergence failure withholds construction.

comparators.name: Pre-stimulus and offset-matched temporal comparisons
comparators.inputs: Prespecified pre/onset/middle/late/post windows on the identical eligible panel.
comparators.procedure: Retain fixed difference-in-differences for500vs1500ms middle and1000vs1500ms late, plus late−onset and post−late contrasts; no favorable sign selection or automatic baseline subtraction.

nuisance_controls: Remove recorded response/button trials over the full stated interval; verify actual stimulus offset within1.01raw samples and no subsequent-stimulus intrusion.

Report source preprocessing/ICA/filter history and the risk of retrospective motor or temporal leakage.
evaluation.uncertainty: Participant SD and SD/sqrt33 are descriptive only. All24contrasts remain visible; calibrated inference and multiple-comparison treatment require separate empirical qualification. No fixed effect direction is rewarded.
evaluation.failure_policy: All33participants,42cells and24contrasts required; finite bounded cells and derived contrasts must agree within1e-12. Validate entire report before reference access. Missing support makes the fixed panel unavailable rather than silently reducing the cohort.
